conditions: $3.45 base per unit only for calculated WFS shipping weight ≤1 lb; apparel, hazmat, low-price and oversize charges can be additional.

Standard eligibility: packaged unit weight ≤150 lb; longest side ≤108 inches; longest side + girth ≤165 inches. Girth = 2 × (width + height). Exceeding any limit means big and bulky, a separate schedule.

Unit weight <1 lb: use unit weight; 1–150 lb: use greater of unit weight or dimensional weight (L × W × H /139, inches including packaging). Add 0.25 lb packaging allowance and round up to nearest pound.
Additional per-unit charges for standard items: Apparel +$0.50; hazardous materials (chemical, aerosol, pesticide or battery) +$0.50; retail price under $10 +$1.

Oversize 1 +$3 if longest side >48–96 inches, median side >30 inches, or longest side + girth >105–130 inches. Oversize 2 +$20 if longest side >96–108 inches or longest side + girth >130–165 inches; unit weight priced starting at 90-lb rate.
These additional standard-item fees do not apply to big and bulky items. April 2025 is month-level schedule evidence, not an exact effective day.
